scope: Two Gaussian memories, cue transport, accepted witness reports about an earlier event, timing bounds, a well-mixed exchange, selected basin observations and direct applications of the finite-interval existence theorem. The extension checks explicit sensory replay versus a retained episode reference and the same-witness paired reports. Seven additional statements distinguish an exact cue visit from leaving and re-entering a specified cue interval at recorded samples, relate cue distance to Gaussian log odds, and separate cue proximity from the retained episode reference. Eleven additional finite statements check which of two unlabelled episodes a witness clue can identify, observationally indistinguishable swapped worlds, and the 36 recorded choices against the resolver.
